description: Company knowledge base (RAG over the company's documents, served by the Company Brain subsystem). Read-only. Use it to answer questions about company data, specifications, documents and people, and to get evidence before acting (e.g. a spec to draw in AutoCAD).

tools.name: knowledge.status
tools.description: Report whether the company knowledge backend is running and reachable.

tools.name: knowledge.search
tools.description: Search the company knowledge base. Returns ranked passages with citations (document name, location, why it matched). Use this to answer questions about company documents, specifications, products or people.

tools.name: knowledge.get_context
tools.description: Retrieve the most relevant company-knowledge passages for a query, formatted as evidence (with citations) to ground your answer or plan. Use before answering a knowledge question or before acting on a company specification.

tools.name: knowledge.read_document
tools.description: Read the full text of a company-knowledge document by its file_id (from knowledge.search results).

tools.name: knowledge.query
tools.description:
Run ONE read-only SQL SELECT over the company catalog to answer exact questions: where a file is (any file on this PC, by name), who created/edited it and when, counts and statistics, duplicate files (GROUP BY sha256 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), extracted facts, version history with diffs, contributions, knowledge-graph relations, knowledge gaps. At most 50 rows. Views (read-only, SQLite):
visible_files(file_id, path, name, ext, size, sha256, fs_created_at, fs_modified_at, fs_owner, doc_author, doc_last_editor, doc_created_at, title, department, project, status, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, tier, version_no, name_key) -- every file on this PC; ext is lower-case WITH the dot ('.pdf', '.docx', '.xlsx'); tier 1 documents, 2 source code, 3 libraries; name_key = name+title lower-case WITHOUT accents: find by name with name_key LIKE '%bao cao%'; status 'active'|'deleted'.
visible_events(event_id, file_id, event, actor, at, detail) -- discovered|modified|moved|deleted|restored.
visible_versions(file_id, file_name, version_no, sha256, size, fs_modified_at, editor, observed_at, diff_added, diff_removed, diff_summary) -- content versions and what changed.
visible_contributions(person, kind, weight, file_id, file_name, project, department, at, evidence) -- score = SUM(weight).
visible_relations(from_name, from_type, relation, to_name, to_type, source_file_id, source_file, evidence, valid_from, valid_to, confidence) -- knowledge graph (people, documents, projects, materials, suppliers...).
visible_facts(fact_id, subject, predicate, value, unit, subject_key, predicate_key, evidence, source_file_id, source_name, source_path, file_id, name, path, author, valid_from, valid_to, confidence, status, note, reviewed_by) -- facts extracted from documents; subject_key lower-case without accents; predicate: uses_material, material_percent, supplier, target_ph, measured_ph, target_viscosity, measured_viscosity, root_cause, corrective_action, test_result, decision, performed_by, belongs_to_project, cost_target, other_property; status: approved > trusted > usable > candidate; conflicted; superseded.
visible_gaps(kind, subject, detail, evidence, status, created_at) -- knowledge gaps.
Times are ISO 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS'. Function norm(text): lower-case, accents removed (WHERE norm(name) LIKE '%cong thuc%').

tools.name: knowledge.update
tools.description: Learn new and changed documents: scan folders into the company catalog and index their content (text, tables, PDFs, images, audio/video) so knowledge.search finds them. Runs in the background and can take minutes to hours; knowledge.status shows progress. Without paths it rescans the whole PC (only new/changed files are processed).
